events.name: Colorado Avalanche at New York Rangers

headlines.description: — Nathan MacKinnon scored 2:46 into overtime for his second goal of the game, helping the Colorado Avalanche top Artemi Panarin and the New York Rangers 3-2 on Saturday.
headlines.shortLinkText: MacKinnon scores twice as the Avalanche beat the Rangers 3-2 in overtime

events.name: Columbus Blue Jackets at Florida Panthers

headlines.description: — Sam Bennett scored 4:56 into overtime, lifting the Florida Panthers to a wild 7-6 victory over the Columbus Blue Jackets on Saturday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Bennett scores in overtime as the Panthers top the Blue Jackets 7-6

events.name: New Jersey Devils at Boston Bruins

headlines.description: — Morgan Geekie scored his 22nd goal, Jeremy Swayman made 29 saves and the Boston Bruins beat New Jersey 4-1 on Saturday night, sending the Devils to their season-high fifth straight loss.
headlines.shortLinkText: Morgan Geekie scores 22nd goal and Jeremy Swayman stops 29 shots as Bruins beat Devils 4-1

events.name: Montreal Canadiens at Toronto Maple Leafs

headlines.description: — Cole Caufield scored in regulation and a shootout, Alexandre Texier had the winner in the tiebreaker and the Montreal Canadiens beat the Toronto Maple Leafs 2-1 on Saturday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Cole Caufield scores in regulation and shootout in Canadiens' 2-1 win over Maple Leafs

events.name: St. Louis Blues at Ottawa Senators

headlines.description: — Joel Hofer made 41 saves, Jake Neighbours scored twice and the St. Louis Blues beat the Ottawa Senators 2-1 on Saturday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Hofer makes 41 saves, Neighbours scores twice in Blues' 2-1 win over the Senators

events.name: New York Islanders at Tampa Bay Lightning

headlines.description: — Ilya Sorokin stopped all 32 shots he faced for his third shutout of the season, tying the Islanders' franchise record for career shutouts, and New York beat the Tampa Bay Lightning 2-0 on Saturday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Sorokin stops 32 shots as Islanders shutout Lightning 2-0

headlines.description: — Jackson Blake had two goals and an assist to help the Carolina Hurricanes beat the Nashville Predators 6-3 on Saturday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Blake has 2 goals and an assist to lead the Hurricanes past the Predators, 6-3

headlines.description: — Dustin Wolf stopped 28 shots for his fifth career shutout and the Calgary Flames beat the Utah Mammoth 2-0 on Saturday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Wolf has 28 saves for 5th career shutout as Flames beat Mammoth 2-0

events.name: Chicago Blackhawks at Los Angeles Kings

headlines.description: — Brandt Clarke scored twice to help Los Angeles break out of an offensive funk, Darcy Kuemper made 23 saves and the Kings beat the Chicago Blackhawks 6-0 on Saturday night to split a two-game set.
headlines.shortLinkText: Clarke scores twice, Kuemper makes 23 saves in Kings' 6-0 romp over Blackhawks

headlines.description: — Leon Draisaitl and Evan Bouchard each had a goal and an assist and the Edmonton Oilers raced past the slumping Winnipeg Jets, 6-2 on Saturday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Oilers score 4 1st-period goals in 6-2 victory over slumping Jets

headlines.description: — Aatu Raty had two goals and an assist, and the Vancouver Canucks beat the Minnesota Wild 4-2 on Saturday night to snap a four-game skid.
headlines.shortLinkText: Raty has 2 goals and an assist as Canucks beat Wild 4-2

events.name: Detroit Red Wings at Seattle Kraken

headlines.description: — Patrick Kane scored the tiebreaking goal with 2:29 remaining in the third period and the Detroit Red Wings beat the Seattle Kraken 4-3 on Saturday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Kane scores late in 3rd period to help Red Wings beat Kraken 4-3
